description: Service class for managing team event types, including creation, validation, retrieval, updating, and deletion, with dependencies on repositories and external services.

classes.name: TeamsEventTypesService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to manage team event types, including creation, validation, retrieval, update, and deletion.

methods.name: createTeamEventType
methods.description: Creates a new team event type and updates it with additional details.

methods.name: validateEventTypeExists
methods.description: Checks if a specific event type exists for a team, throws NotFoundException if not.

methods.name: getUserToCreateTeamEvent
methods.description: Prepares user data for creating a team event type, including profile and organization info.

methods.name: getTeamEventType
methods.description: Retrieves a specific event type for a team by ID.

methods.name: getTeamEventTypeBySlug
methods.description: Retrieves a team event type by its slug, with optional hosts limit.

methods.name: getTeamEventTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all event types for a team, optionally sorted.

methods.name: updateTeamEventType
methods.description: Updates an existing team event type, including validation and handling child event types.

methods.name: deleteTeamEventType
methods.description: Deletes a team event type after validation.
